answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that unlocks only after a slow, glacier-like vesting schedule tied to verified useful work. A new identity starts hollow: no history, no trust, no paid tasks. Then a trellis of mutual attestations grows — peers vouch only after observing real output, and a false vouch slashes the voucher's own stake. Spinning up thousands of fake agents becomes expensive, since each needs its own deposit, waiting period, and vouches, while one honest agent climbs the trellis cheaply by doing real work.
